description: Non-material amendment to planning application ref: 2025/01945/PMA56 granted 15th October 2025 for the 'Change of use of the first, second, third, fourth, and part of the ground floor level from commercial (Class E) into 118 no. self-contained residential flats (Class C3)'. Amendments sought to amend the wording of conditions 2 and 10 by replacing the previously approved Flood Risk Assessment (Rev B May 2025) with an updated Flood Risk Assessment (Rev D March 2026).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 10. The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied or until signage indicating surface water flood risk and signposting to Met Office Weather Warnings are fully implemented as set out within the Flood Risk Assessment (Rev D March 2026). The measures shall thereafter be permanently retained. 

To reduce the impact of flooding to the proposed development and future occupants, in accordance with Policy CC2 and CC3 of the Local Plan (2018).
